title: Design System: Rizvi FE Assignment Portal

display.purpose: Main top-level view titles (28px Inter Bold).

mono.purpose: Student UINs, mathematical formulas, solution key parameters, and dynamic variable chips.

shadows.name: shadow-level-1
shadows.purpose: Resting cards, header bar, and static container elements.

shadows.name: shadow-level-2
shadows.purpose: Card hover state and active focal elements.

shadows.name: shadow-level-3
shadows.purpose: Digital assignment paper canvas and floating toast notifications.

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Fast transitions for button hovers, tab switches, and role toggle buttons.

motion.name: transition-normal
motion.purpose: Normal transitions for modal overlay fades and card elevation shifts.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button for form submissions and primary CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary { background: #0066CC; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0077ED; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 102, 204, 0.25); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E5E5E7; color: #1D1D1F; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F2F2F2; border-color: #C7C7CC; }

components.name: Form Input
components.description: Standard text input field with halo focus ring.
components.css: .ds-form-input { height: 42px; padding: 0 12px; background: #F5F5F7; border: 1px solid #E5E5E7; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; color: #1D1D1F; outline: none; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-form-input:focus { border-color: #0066CC; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 102, 204, 0.15); background: #FFFFFF; }

components.name: Variable Substitution Chip
components.description: Monospaced inline chip highlighting dynamic student-unique variable parameters.
components.css: .ds-var-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 6px; background: #E8F0FB; color: #0066CC; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 102, 204, 0.2); }

narrative.overview: A light-mode design system built on Apple & Linear aesthetic principles. It pairs crisp typography (Inter for UI layout, JetBrains Mono for dynamic formulas) with clean light surfaces (#F5F5F7 background, #FFFFFF cards), subtle 1px structural borders (#E5E5E7), a 4-tier elevation shadow system, and a restrained institutional Royal Blue accent (#0066CC).
keyCharacteristics: Prism-Clean Light Mode Palette (#F5F5F7 background with crisp #FFFFFF surface cards)
Dual-Font System (Inter for UI layout, JetBrains Mono for dynamic formulas and UINs)
Structured 4-Tier Elevation System (from flat border rest states to 64px modal blurs)
900px High-Fidelity Paper Canvas format for student sheet rendering and printing

rules.name: The Rarity of Blue Rule
rules.body: Primary accent blue (#0066CC) is reserved strictly for interactive focus points and active navigation. It covers ≤10% of any screen surface to preserve its visual weight.

rules.name: The Dual-Font Protocol Rule
rules.body: Never mix sans-serif and mono fonts inside numerical inputs or formulas. All variable numbers, calculations, and solution parameters must render in JetBrains Mono.

rules.name: The Progressive Elevation Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never jump more than one elevation shadow level during interaction. Resting level-1 cards transition strictly to level-2 on hover.

dos: Do use #F5F5F7 for application body background and #FFFFFF for elevated content cards
Do wrap all student-unique numerical values in .var-chip elements using JetBrains Mono
Do apply strict 1px #E5E5E7 border lines to demarcate structured sections
Do preserve the centered 900px canvas max-width for student assignment sheet views
donts: Don't introduce saturated dark mode backgrounds or heavy dark drop shadows
Don't mix sans-serif and monospaced typography within the same numerical entry field
Don't bypass the 4-level shadow scale with arbitrary custom CSS drop-shadows
Don't alter the hardcoded 5 engineering branch or 6 department taxonomy tags
